title: Neighbor moved to Roswell to see UFOs

tellings.quote: And he moved to Roswell, New Mexico because he wanted to be close. He claimed he did see something.

plain: A man is said to have moved to Roswell, New Mexico, the town known for a reported UFO crash in the 1940s, because he wanted to be close to the sightings, and he claimed he did see something. An unnamed audience member tells this about his neighbor at a filmed event with David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who became a UFO whistleblower. The audience member does not say what the neighbor saw.
